name: dsh-terminal
description: Terminal: a live transcript of the agent's OWN command use, in a bottom dock of the vncode Web GUI. A header button (the last entry in the header's utilities list, left of the right bar's toggle) opens a horizontal panel that starts at the right edge of the left bar, runs to the full width of the page and sits UNDER the middle and right columns, which make room for it while the left bar keeps its full height and its layout untouched. Inside is ONE view and nothing else: the commands the conversation recorded (bash/pwsh/run_code/terminal_send, grouped under the prompt that asked for them, with exit status, duration and output, filterable to commands only or failures only, Copy command / Copy output per row, and a follow-the-tail pill), read from the HOST's own copy of the conversation log through ONE read-only route, so it fills in as soon as the app opens, pauses while the tab is hidden and polls briskly only while a command is actually running. The bar wears that log's own state - a pulse while a command runs, the count of what failed, a warning when the conversation's log cannot be read here, and the counts in its tooltip - and the header control carries the same dot while the panel is closed. ALPHA.12 REMOVED THE TERMINALS, and that is the shape of this package now: the dock used to hold its own xterm.js emulators, one real PTY each behind an authenticated WebSocket, and the whole half is gone - 0.2's right Sidebar ships terminal TABS of its own, so a second emulator at the foot of the window was a second answer to a question the harness answers in the column beside it. No shell is spawned, no engine is vendored, no socket is gated and there is no Run in Terminal; the package reads and never runs, which is why it injects `connection` alone. Alpha.
